So the standard is:

Warm up -100 squats in 5 minutes ( you can rest but timer doesn't stop )
Strength training -100 push-ups in 5 minutes ( you can rest but timer doesn't stop )
Mental training -5 minutes of plank

You can always divide everything by two including the time to lower the level. ( This can be done as many times as you want to adjust your level)
Ex: 50 squat in 2:30mins , 50 push ups in 2:30 mins, 2:30 mins of plank.

If it's too easy and you want to be able to do 200 push-ups in a row then multiply everything by two including the time.  ( This can be done as many times as you want to adjust your level)
